name: Giants of the Green
description: Ten of the biggest trunks measured on campus, all on the University Green: four silver maples, a 49-inch red oak, a sugar maple, a dawn redwood, two ashes and a Norway spruce.

name: Native or not
description: Six pairs on Central Campus, each a tree brought from elsewhere beside a Vermont native of the same kind: Norway and sugar maple, Scotch and white pine, Norway and white spruce, Lombardy poplar and bigtooth aspen, kousa and flowering dogwood, blue and white spruce.
